title: Concept: OS command execution via x.execute (groovy) — review required
description: In groovy, x.execute executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (list .execute() with separate arguments) are groovy-specific.
applicability: groovy codebases that launch external processes through x.execute; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
